falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 total return is at least +7% versus the verdict-day close within 14 calendar days, and VIX closes at or below 15 on the final session of that window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug analog resolved into a confirmed risk-on rebound. HOLD/UNKNOWN would be wrong because the path was directional enough to require a long/risk-on call.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 total return is -7% or worse versus the verdict-day close within 14 calendar days, and ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by at least 50 basis points versus the verdict-day close.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price and credit stress extended instead of basing. The 75% match to bottom_2024_aug and the HOLD would be invalidated; the correct call would have been risk-off.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes at or above 30 on at least two sessions in the next 14 calendar days, and the 10-year Treasury yield moves at least 30 basis points from the verdict-day close in either direction.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A named vol-and-rates regime break occurred. Phase could no longer stay Unknown and signal could no longer stay HOLD; blowoff score 39 would also be inconsistent with that stress impulse.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
